title: extends listed in a refinement are added to the base view's extends
rule: extends in a refinement is appended to the view's extends, and the last listed view wins conflicts.

citations.quote: When extends is used in a refinement, the value in the extends parameter is appended
to the list of items extended in the original object or in previous refinements, if any.
Then, if there are any conflicts, priority is given to the last item in the chain of extends.
